6cc0f7c2-0db6-432b-8189-fcedbcdda888.title: Hitomi-chan wa Hitomishiri
6cc0f7c2-0db6-432b-8189-fcedbcdda888.description: One day, the ordinary 2nd year high schooler Yuu Usami accidentally encounters a big girl with a scary look. Turns out she's glaring at him, but why...!? Although Hitomi Takano looks like she's scary and awkward, she's actually a kind and adorable girl.

f89ed57a-e4c0-48f5-b664-8ef88aa87fd9.title: Ibeon Saengeun Gajuga Doegetseumnida
f89ed57a-e4c0-48f5-b664-8ef88aa87fd9.altTitle: In This Life, I'll Become the Head of the Family
f89ed57a-e4c0-48f5-b664-8ef88aa87fd9.description:
Aku pikir aku adalah putri bangsawan yang hidupnya bergelimang harta dan kebahagiaan, tapi ternyata aku ini anak berdarah campuran bangsawan dan rakyat biasa yang keberadaannya tidak dianggap dalam keluargaku sendiri. Ibuku sudah tiada dan tidak ada yang menyayangiku kecuali ayahku sendiri. Setelah bekerja keras mengabdikan diri untuk keluarga ini, siapa sangka aku malah diusir dan berakhir mati tertabrak kereta kuda. Ketika terbangun lagi aku bereinkarnasi untuk kedua kalinya di tubuh yang sama.

0ab4fbb8-4eba-4722-b6d2-7a51d39b1b8b.altTitle: If They Find Out I’m a Mandrake, Do I Get Slain?: The Flower Witch's Smile Sows the Seeds of Misunderstanding
0ab4fbb8-4eba-4722-b6d2-7a51d39b1b8b.description: Having met an unfortunate end, Misaki is reincarnated as an extraordinary mandrake that transforms into a deadly monster just by screaming! Determined to finally enjoy a happy (human?) life, she manages to take on a human form, but her inability to speak causes all sorts of misunderstandings, leading people to worship her as the "Flower Witch"... While dreading being hunted if her true nature is revealed, she struggles to achieve a peaceful life!!

6251f857-38ca-46c5-8a6c-5dd495810552.title: Nise Seiken Monogatari - Osananajimi no Seijo wo Uttara Michizure ni Sareta
6251f857-38ca-46c5-8a6c-5dd495810552.altTitle: Fake Holy Sword Story: I Was Taken Along When I Sold Out My Childhood Friend, The Saint
6251f857-38ca-46c5-8a6c-5dd495810552.description:
My childhood friend, Magary, was chosen to be the saint. From here on out, she'll have to maintain a smile at all times while at the royal capital and take lessons in etiquette and dance. She'll be living in an excruciatingly stifling world. Having been together since birth, there was naturally one thought in my mind.

While feeling a little bit of loneliness... I pushed my childhood friend (who was trying to escape with all her might with her arms still bound) towards the knight that came to pick her up.

"Alistaaaaaaaaaaaaar!!"
  
I feel as if there was some deep resentment in her voice, but that's probably just my imagination. As her last act of futile resistance, she had me see her off to the royal capital… but, that ended without any problems.

"Now that that's over with, I'll be heading home. Good luck ^^"

I turned my back towards my childhood friend who looked me with deep resentment in her eyes. While I was making my way home... I had to turn around as I was chased by goblins.

"Noooooooo!! Someone, helpppppppp!!"

09e6e501-b38b-410e-9856-f4e5b1b61481.title: The Little Princess and Her Monster Prince
09e6e501-b38b-410e-9856-f4e5b1b61481.description:
Aku masuk kedalam tubuh Ancia, istri putra mahkota yang mengerikan, Blake, dalam novel roman R-19. Dalam cerita aslinya, Ancia bunuh diri di hari pernikahan mereka, membuat Blake mengalami trauma yang sangat besar. Tapi kali ini, Ancia tidak akan melakukan hal seperti itu. Blake adalah pemeran utama pria kedua dalam novel aslinya. Dia digambarkan sebagai binatang buas. Namun, saat ini, dia berperilaku seperti kelinci yang tidak bersalah. Satu-satunya orang yang dapat menghapus kutukan putra mahkota adalah sang pahlawan wanita, Diana. Peranku adalah menjaga agar anak kecil ini tidak terluka dan kemudian mundur tepat waktu, Tapi….. "Ancia, jangan tinggalkan aku!" Kelinci kecil ini terus mengejarku.

96338481-0531-4a25-b209-152e4178684b.title: Radiation House
96338481-0531-4a25-b209-152e4178684b.description:
Iori Igarashi is a talented radiology technician who has patiently waited for his chance to work with An Amakasu, his childhood friend. After being hired at her family's hospital, he is determined to fulfill a promise that he made with An when they were younger. 

Unfortunately, having been out of touch for years, she doesn't recognize him and it doesn't help that she also isn't a fan of the way he performs his duties. As all sorts of cases come into the department, she must acknowledge his skills and learn to work together so that patients can receive the best treatment possible. 

While the two of them adapt to each other, will An recognize her childhood friend, who has been working with her all this time?
___
